fusions.name: Gale Run
fusions.desc: Sweeps you in to a target up to 7 tiles away and strikes, dealing 12 damage, rising to twice that at full reach.

fusions.name: Thudding Ring
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground in a ring, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after each one.

fusions.name: Pattering Takeoff
fusions.desc: Carries you 6 tiles forward. You move 25% faster for 5 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Galloping Shallows

riders.text: and gain 10% dodge chance on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 15% faster over it, and from silver you gain 10% dodge chance on it.
